newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil mulls 15-year Treasury notes - newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil mulls 15-year Treasury notes - newspaper.

text.p: The Brazilian government is considering the possibility of launching Treasury notes with a maturity period of over 15 years tied to the variation of a price index, Gazeta Mercantil financial newspaper said.
Another alternative would be the creation of a new paper with an average maturity period of five years, it added.
The launch of new securities would be part of the government's strategy to stretch the maturity of its public debt, Gazeta said.
